properties.label: pretreatment time
properties.description: The time for which cells are in contact with an agent before the main treatment starts.

properties.label: median lethal concentration (LC₅₀)
properties.description: The concentration of a substance that kills half of the organisms in a test, for example the embryos in a fish embryo toxicity test.

properties.label: mortality
properties.description: The percentage of the organisms in a test that die.

properties.label: specific enzyme activity
properties.description: The activity of an enzyme in a sample, divided by the mass of the protein in the sample.

evidence.quote: MCF-7
IC₅₀
CV2 (μM)
IC₅₀: Concentration that reduces 50% of cell viability.
or Doxorubicin (DXR) against Human Tumor and Nontumor Cell Lines After 72 h of Treatment
The data are expressed as mean ± standard error of the mean (SEM) from three independent experiments performed in triplicate (n = 3)
IC₅₀ values were estimated by nonlinear regression using a four-parameter logistic model based on log-transformed concentration–response curves.
CV2 exhibited cytotoxic activity against all tumor cell lines evaluated after 72 h of treatment
MCF-7 breast cancer cells were the most sensitive to the compound (IC₅₀ = 4.63 ± 0.16 μM)
CV2 exhibited potent cytotoxic activity against MCF-7 cells (IC₅₀= 4.63 ± 0.16 μM)
and 4.63 ± 0.16 μM at 72 h
CV2 cytotoxicity was assessed using the 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium (MTT) assay

Cells were seeded in 96-well plates (Guangzhou Jet Bio-Filtration Co., Ltd., Guangzhou, China) at a density of 3 × 10⁵ cells/mL (MCF-7, HCT-116, MDA-MB-231, HeLa, SK-MEL-128, or MCF-10A) or 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL (PBMCs) and incubated at 37 °C with 5% CO₂
After 24 h, the cells were treated with 100 μL of CV2 (3.12–200 μM for human tumor cell lines and MCF-10A; 1.25–20 μM for PBMCs) or doxorubicin (DXR) (0.15–5 μM), which was used as the standard drug
The negative control group received culture medium containing the vehicle (DMSO) only
The final DMSO concentration did not exceed 0.1% (v/v), and control cells were exposed to the same vehicle concentration used in the treated groups
After the incubation period (24, 48, or 72 h, as applicable), the supernatant (110 μL) was removed and MTT solution (10 μL, 5 mg/mL in PBS) was added and incubated (5% CO2, 37 °C) for 4 h
The precipitated formazan crystals were dissolved with sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) (100 μL/well) overnight
the optical density was measured using a microplate reader (Synergy HT, BioTek, Winooski, VT, USA) at λ = 570 nm and is used to estimate the IC₅₀ (half maximal inhibitory concentration) values

Cells were collected by centrifugation (500 × g, 20 °C, 5 min), washed with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS), fixed in ice-cold 70% ethanol, and stored at −20 °C until analysis

For cell analysis, cells were recovered by centrifugation (400 × g, 4 °C, 10 min), permeabilized with 1% Triton X-100 for 30 min at room temperature, washed with PBS, and incubated with RNase (0.1 mg/mL) and propidium iodide (PI; 0.05 mg/mL) in the dark for 30 min
Samples were analyzed using a BD FACSCanto II flow cytometer (BD Biosciences, Woburn, MA, USA), and 10,000 events were acquired per sample
